gbm_pt01_classical_egfrvIII.title: Patient GBM-01: Classical Subtype EGFRvIII/PTEN-loss (Stupp Failure)
gbm_pt01_classical_egfrvIII.citation: Brennan et al. (2013) Cell; Verhaak et al. (2010) Cancer Cell

clinical_history.primary_driver: EGFRvIII mutation, PTEN deletion, CDKN2A loss, unmethylated MGMT
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Rapid recurrence at 5.1 months, deceased at 11.2 months (Chemoresistant)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Unmethylated MGMT neutralized TMZ alkylation; EGFRvIII/AKT maintained continuous anti-apoptotic survival

gbm_pt02_mesenchymal_radiation_relapse.title: Patient GBM-02: Mesenchymal Subtype Post-Radiation/Bevacizumab Relapse
gbm_pt02_mesenchymal_radiation_relapse.citation: Verhaak et al. (2010) Cancer Cell; TCGA-GBM Mesenchymal Cohort

clinical_history.primary_driver: MET high, Hypoxia/Necrosis, TP53 mutation, PTEN loss, CDKN2A loss
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Highly refractory invasive relapse, progression at 3.9 months, death at 8.7 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: MET-driven STAT3 activation and severe hypoxia driving NF-kB and MCL-1/BCL-xL; TP53 mutation blocks apoptosis

gbm_pt03_proneural_pdgfra_driven.title: Patient GBM-03: Proneural Subtype PDGFRA-Driven (TMZ Refractory)
gbm_pt03_proneural_pdgfra_driven.citation: Brennan et al. (2013) Cell; Phillips et al. (2006) Cancer Cell

clinical_history.primary_driver: PDGFRA amplification, CDKN2A deletion, TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Early local recurrence at 4.4 months, death at 10.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: PDGFRA hyperactivation driving RAS/MEK/ERK; CDKN2A deletion disables RB1 cell cycle arrest

gbm_pt04_mgmt_methylated_responder.title: Patient GBM-04: Exceptional Stupp Protocol Long-Term Survivor (MGMT Methylated)
gbm_pt04_mgmt_methylated_responder.citation: Stupp et al. (2005) NEJM; Hegi et al. (2005) NEJM

clinical_history.primary_driver: MGMT promoter methylated (silenced), PTEN intact, TP53 wild-type
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Standard Stupp Protocol (Concomitant TMZ/RT followed by 6 cycles adjuvant TMZ)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete therapeutic response, progression-free survival >36 months (SURVIVED / Remission)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Silenced MGMT prevents repair of O6-methylguanine lesions; intact p53 triggers cell cycle arrest and apoptosis

gbm_pt05_erlotinib_failure_pten_loss.title: Patient GBM-05: Targeted Therapy EGFR TKI Relapse (PTEN-Loss Bypass)
gbm_pt05_erlotinib_failure_pten_loss.citation: Mellinghoff et al. (2005) NEJM 353:2012-2024; Haas-Kogan et al. (2005) JCO

clinical_history.primary_driver: EGFR amplification/EGFRvIII, PTEN loss, unmethylated MGMT
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete resistance to Erlotinib, rapid radiological progression at 2.1 months, death at 5.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: PTEN loss leaves PI3K/Akt constitutively active, decoupling downstream survival from EGFR inhibition

gbm_pt06_hypoxic_stem_pseudopalisade.title: Patient GBM-06: Deep Pseudopalisading Necrosis & Stem Dormancy
gbm_pt06_hypoxic_stem_pseudopalisade.citation: Brat et al. (2004) Cancer Res; TCGA-GBM Perinecrotic Cohort

clinical_history.primary_driver: Severe hypoxia niche, MET activation, PTEN loss, TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Early regional recurrence with ependymal seeding, deceased at 6.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Hypoxic induction of MET and NF-kB drives XIAP and MCL-1 expression, insulating cells against alkylating agents

gbm_pt07_cdk4_amplified_escape.title: Patient GBM-07: CDK4/MDM2 Co-Amplified Cell Cycle Escape
gbm_pt07_cdk4_amplified_escape.citation: Brennan et al. (2013) Cell; TCGA-GBM Case #7

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Fulminant mitotic progression, recurrence at 4.0 months, death at 9.3 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Excess MDM2 degrades P53 despite wild-type status; CDK4 hyperactivation irreversibly inactivates RB1

gbm_pt08_secondary_mesenchymal_transitio.title: Patient GBM-08: Recurrent Secondary MDR Post-Temozolomide Relapse
gbm_pt08_secondary_mesenchymal_transitio.citation: Wang et al. (2016) Nature Genetics 48:1029-1037; TCGA-GBM Recurrence Cohort

clinical_history.primary_driver: Pan-RTK co-activation (EGFRvIII + MET + PDGFRA), PTEN loss, TP53 mut, CDKN2A loss
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Refractory to all therapies, widespread leptomeningeal progression, death at 4.6 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Multi-RTK redundancy coupled with complete loss of tumor suppressors (PTEN, TP53, CDKN2A); massive mitochondrial anti-apoptotic shield (MCL1/BCLxL/XIAP)
